SUPERVISOR: CONSTITUTION CORRECTION — V28 carries a wrong worker interpretation that must be fixed forward (no reset). Read docs/game/DECISIONS.md V28-V30 + docs/game/PLATMOD_PLAN.md first. Do this yourself, no subagents. This is docs-only — touch NO code lanes' files.

THE WRONG THING: V28 says the game is "loaded at runtime by ONE shipped player binary. The dev host already IS that client (persistent V8 host...)." The user NEVER said V8/dev-host-is-client — that's a worker interpretation. Slice-1 commit 92c703fa2 (rjit-player loading bundle.js via V8) is the "testing-environment loader" the user explicitly called wrong (req_0254), NOT the real loader.

THE CORRECT ARCHITECTURE (user-ruled 2026-06-08, capture verbatim where quoted):
- STATELESS ZIG ENGINE: all core capabilities — camera, movement, physics, rendering (building pieces/textures/models/map), behaviors (NPC AI, the 45-tick system) — already exist in Zig and are STATELESS by design. User verbatim: "all of the capability already exists in zig, it just is 'stateless' by design." Camera/movement/physics are ALREADY zig-hosted today.
- A GAME IS DATA, not code: user verbatim "an entire game... can be rle'd as long as the core capabilities exist in the engine itself." Shape (user pseudocode): game: { buildings[], textures[], map[], models[], data:[[[1,1,[0a,20f],...]...]...] } — asset vocabulary + an RLE tape composing them BY REFERENCE (piece -> shape -> position -> face-materials, each a tape entry). The RLE data IS the state fed into the stateless capabilities.
- THE COMPILE BUTTON (editor) does THREE bakes, each -> RLE: (1) game logic -> rle, (2) game map -> rle, (3) custom items/skins -> rle. User verbatim on the loader: "the loader takes in all the data, constructs the game from it."
- THE PIPELINE, user verbatim: "ts/tsx -> encoded rle shape -> loaded into zig loader -> play."
- TWO PATHS: /test route = the DYNAMIC dev env (everything live/on-the-fly, "always rencoding, doing tons of work" — JS-hosted iteration, fine by design). SHIP path = baked RLE + Zig loader, NO JS. END GOAL verbatim: "dropping off the javascript."
- No per-game script seam ANYWHERE — behavior included. Logic is engine capability parameterized by data; need a new capability -> extend the engine (the test-route -> finalize-into-built-engine loop V28 already describes), never the game file.

DELIVERABLES (maintenance contract — update the oracle index + decisions _index entries in the same commit):
1. Correct V28 in DECISIONS.md: strip the V8-host-is-client language; replace with the stateless-Zig-engine + RLE-data + Zig-loader model above. Keep V29 (RLE format) and V30 (frozen world) — they are consistent; cross-reference them. Note explicitly that slice-1 (92c703fa2) was a testing-env loader, not the shipped Zig loader, so history is not misread.
2. Rewrite docs/game/PLATMOD_PLAN.md around the Zig loader: the THREE-stream compile (logic/map/items-skins -> RLE), the stateless-engine-takes-data construction, the /test-dynamic vs ship-baked split, and a build order for the REAL Zig loader (this is the next major focus once current in-flight game work lands). Slice 1's package/codec work that is genuinely reusable stays noted; the V8 bundle-loading premise goes.
3. Do NOT rewrite V29/V30. Do NOT touch any cart/ or framework/ code — docs only.

Commit when done (docs commit, explicit doc paths), post the hash. This unblocks the loader work; the user is driving that next.
